quantity: Mean sea-ice concentration over target_start..target_end (7-day mean, not daily, not anomaly)
grid: NSIDC Polar Stereographic South 25 km (EPSG:3412), 332 x 316

warnings: Atmospheric inputs available for 0/7 days; atmospheric features set to missing.
Using the SIC-only fallback model (declared before test; its test metrics are reported separately).

provenance.sic_source: NOAA/NSIDC CDR of Passive Microwave SIC v6 (G02202), doi:10.7265/b18j-z797
provenance.atmosphere_source: not available for this issue date (NCEP R1 dailies at NOAA PSL end 2026-03-17 at retrieval time)

limitations: Statistical forecast of the 7-day MEAN concentration; it does not resolve day-to-day variability.
Trained on the NOAA/NSIDC passive-microwave CDR v6 (25 km); inherits its biases (melt-pond / thin-ice underestimation, coastal land spill-over).
Atmospheric predictors are PAST-week NCEP/NCAR R1 means (interim substitute for ERA5); no weather forecast of the target week is used.
Extent uses the 15 % threshold on the forecast 7-day-mean field; it is not identical to the mean of daily extents.
Not reviewed by an independent sea-ice expert; not for operational navigation.
